description:
CoinAPI only (provider=coinapi). Executed trades and taker buy/sell volume for one exact CoinAPI spot instrument over an explicit UTC window of at most 24 hours. Defaults to 100 trades, maximum 1,000. Volume delta and cumulative volume delta describe only returned trades, in the instrument's quote currency. Unknown taker sides remain unknown. Trades do not reconstruct resting bids or liquidation levels.

[Access: pay 0.01 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

provider.description: Optional upstream override; omitted uses the existing server default.

symbol_id.description: Exact provider spot instrument identifier, including venue, SPOT, base, and quote.

time_end.description: ISO 8601 UTC-aware end timestamp; after start and at most 24 hours later.

name: get_order_flow
